subject: स्पंदन - एक नई शृंखला
title: स्पंदन - नई साहित्यिक शृंखला
body: The Cultural Affairs secretary announces 'स्पंदन', a weekly literary series where new literary pieces will be posted on the club's Instagram handle for literature enthusiasts.

subject: Fwd: Invitation to Participate in the Emerging Technologies Hackathon 2026
title: Emerging Technologies Hackathon 2026
body:
Register by 21 July.

The Emerging Technologies Hackathon 2026 invites students to participate, with registration open until the deadline. An online information session will provide details.

subject: Fwd: Participate in Aerothon 2026 – HAL × IIT Indore National Aerospace Hackathon
title: Aerothon 2026 – HAL × IIT Indore Hackathon
body:
Register by 15 July 2026.

A national-level aerospace hackathon organized by HAL and IIT Indore, open for student participation.

subject: The Integral Cup 2026 Season 2
title: Integral Cup 2026 Season 2
body:
Register at theintegralcup.in.

The Integral Cup 2026 Season 2 is a nationwide undergraduate mathematics competition featuring three rounds (preliminary, campus finals, grand finale) open to all Indian university undergraduates.

subject: Fwd: Invitation to participate in AU Inter-University Essay Writing Competition 2026
title: AU Inter-University Essay Writing Competition
body:
Submit your essay before the deadline.

Students are invited to submit essays for an inter‑university competition organized by Adamas University, with cash prizes and merit certificates, in English, Bengali, or Hindi.

subject: Kalpana Chawla Chhatravrati Yojna For Engineering Students (Girls Only)
title: Kalpana Chawla Chhatravrati Yojna Scholarship
body:
Apply through the provided link.

The Kalpana Chawla Chhatravrati Yojna offers a scholarship exclusively for female engineering students, with application guidelines and the application portal provided in the email.

subject: Inviting applications for "Vidyalakshmi Help the Blind Foundation Scholarship" for Visually Impaired students for Academic Year 2026-27.
title: Vidyalakshmi Help the Blind Foundation Scholarship
body:
Submit the application before July 08, 2026.

The SCSP office invites applications for the Vidyalakshmi Help the Blind Foundation Scholarship for visually impaired students enrolled at IIT Roorkee for the 2026-27 academic year, covering tuition and living expenses subject to income and disability certificate requirements.

subject: Commencement of application process for various Scholarships on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) for the Academic Year 2026-27.
title: Application Process for Various Scholarships
body:
Submit applications on NSP and hard copy.

Students are informed that applications for multiple scholarships for the 2026-27 academic year are now open on the National Scholarship Portal and must be submitted online and in hard copy to the SCSP Office.

subject: Financial Assistance for Needy UG Students
title: Financial Assistance for Needy UG Students
body:
Apply using the Google Form by 20 July 2026.

The Wellness Centre offers up to Rs 1,00,000 per academic year to undergraduate students whose family income is below Rs 8,00,000 to help pay semester fees. Eligible students must apply via the provided Google Form.

subject: Fwd: Notification: ACADEMIC REGISTRATION FOR AUTUMN SEMESTER 2026-27 FOR ALL EXISTING UG & PG STUDENTS
title: Academic Registration for Autumn Semester 2026-27
body:
Complete academic registration.

A reminder to all existing undergraduate and postgraduate students to complete academic registration for the Autumn Semester 2026-27.

subject: Gentle Remider: Notification: Fee Payment for Autumn Semester 2026-27
title: Fee Payment for Autumn Semester
body:
Pay the Institute Fee before the deadline.

Students are reminded to pay the Institute Fee for the Autumn Semester 2026-27 before the deadline to avoid a late fee.

subject: Revised Academic Calendar for Autumn Semester 2026-27.
title: Revised Academic Calendar for Autumn Semester 2026-27
body:
Review the revised academic calendar.

The email shares a revised academic calendar for the Autumn Semester 2026-27 and provides a link to view it on the institute website.

subject: Revised swimming pool slots and timings
title: Revised swimming pool slots and timings
body: The Institute Sports Council announces updated swimming pool time slots for male and female sessions, effective from 21 July 2026, detailing morning and evening timings and usage rules.

subject: Closure of football field for maintenance
title: Closure of football field for maintenance
body: The football ground is closed until further notice for maintenance, surface levelling, and grass restoration work.

subject: Re: NSS IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026–27 | Applications Open for 2nd Year UG & PG Students
title: NSS IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026-27
body:
Submit the application form before the deadline.

The NSS IIT Roorkee invites 2nd‑year UG and PG students to apply for recruitment across domains such as Education, Central Events, Operations, Relations, Sustainability, and Allied Works.

subject: Tinkering Lab Recruitment – Summer Assignment
title: Tinkering Lab Recruitment – Summer Assignment
body:
Submit the summer assignment by the deadline.

Tinkering Lab IIT Roorkee is recruiting upcoming UG second‑year students for software development and Metaverse & XR roles, requiring a summer assignment to be submitted by the deadline.

subject: Call For E-Sports PoRs Applications | 2026-27
title: Call For E-Sports PoRs Applications
body:
Submit the application form by the deadline.

The ESports IITR Committee is accepting applications for Secretary, Additional Secretary, and Joint Secretary positions, open to UG and PG students in their pre-final or final year enrolled in 2026-27.

subject: Live Project as a Stock Market Analyst | Finlatics
title: Finlatics Stock Market Analyst Program
body:
Apply via the provided link.

Finlatics offers an online two‑month Stock Market Analyst live project for IIT Roorkee students, providing a certificate, recommendation letter, and practical equity market exposure.

subject: Fwd: SiB Fellowship 2026 (September Batch) Advertisement
title: SiB Fellowship 2026 (September Batch)
body:
Submit the application by 30 June 2026.

The School of International Biodesign invites students to apply for the full‑time India Biodesign Innovation Fellowship, offering a stipend of Rs 60,000 per month.

subject: Online Certification Course from IIT Roorkee - "Samkhya and Yoga Sutras for Contemporary Life and Modern Science"
title: Online Certification Course: Samkhya and Yoga Sutras
body:
Register before 26 July 2026.

The Center for IKS offers a self‑paced online certification course on Samkhya and Yoga Sutras, open to IIT Roorkee participants who can register by the deadline.

subject: Fwd: Call for Organizers: Pragyotsav 2026 Recruitment | Sanskrit Club
title: Organizers Recruitment for Pragyotsav 2026
body:
Submit the application form by the deadline.

The Sanskrit Club is recruiting UG second‑year and upcoming second‑year students to join the organizing team of Pragyotsav 2026, its annual Sanskrit fest.
